c74object.name: tap.reel~
c74object.digest: One free-running tape loop — the lane tap.airport~ is made of
c74object.description: The tap.reel~ object is a single tape loop with one head that both plays and records. tap.airport~ is up to eight of these summed and nothing more, so several tap.reel~ at deliberately awkward lengths patched into a stereo sum are the Music for Airports system — with every loop reachable. That gets you what the monolith cannot: an insert on one phrase, a varispeed on one reel, more than eight loops, and tape bought per reel rather than eight worst-case reels whether you use them or not. The discipline is the same one loop deep: nothing resets the phase — not record, not a setter, not a length change (a splice: the head re-wraps modulo the new length and never rewinds).

objarg.name: maxloop
objarg.description: Worst-case loop length in seconds (default 30). The reel is bought at DSP start — about 11 MB of tape at 48 kHz at the default; size it to the piece.

inlet.digest: Audio input — punched onto the tape while recording.

method.name: signal
method.description: Audio to be punched onto the tape while the record gate is open.

method.name: record
method.description: Punch the input onto the tape at wherever the head happens to be (1), or freeze the tape bit-exactly (0). Recording replaces — no overdub; there is no quantized punch-in, and the phase is never reset.

method.name: phase
method.description: Report the head position as a fraction of the loop length (0..1) out the right outlet.

method.name: loopsamples
method.description: Report the loop length in samples, and in seconds as quantized to the sample grid, out the right outlet — what you need to work out when a set of reels realigns.

method.name: clear
method.description: Erase the tape and rewind the head. Parameters are kept.

attribute.name: maxloop
attribute.description: Worst-case loop length in seconds (set by the first object argument). Changing it erases the tape when the DSP chain restarts.

attribute.name: length
attribute.description: Loop length in seconds (0.5 up to maxloop). Across several reels the lengths are the score: keep them incommensurate and the coincidences never repeat. A change is a splice — the head re-wraps and never rewinds. It can click; splices do.

attribute.name: level
attribute.description: Linear playback level, slewed. Unclamped (negative flips polarity, like a mixer).

attribute.name: pan
attribute.description: Equal-power pan, -1 (hard left) to 1 (hard right), slewed. Endpoints are exact: a hard-panned reel is bitwise absent from the far bus.

attribute.name: darken
attribute.description: Playback darkening corner in Hz. A static tone, not generation loss (a frozen loop replays the same imprint every pass); at 20000 (the default) the stage is bypassed and playback is bit-transparent.

attribute.name: smooth
attribute.description: Anti-zipper ramp time for level, pan, and darken moves, in milliseconds (0 = instant).
